header: THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. Every entry names a declared permission with no current-policy evaluator binding. An entry acknowledges the gap; it does not authorize access.

The current-policy binding registry is checked separately against the normalized permission action, id and resource. Bound permissions must leave this list, and a declared permission in neither place refuses the release build.
Queue row AUTH emptied both package lists by binding every supported permission to the deny-by-default current-policy evaluator.
